note: Clean-room, Sentinel-authored from CWE-703. Bandit flags bare/broad except and asserts; most are not security issues.
questions: Does the flagged construct suppress or ignore an error that guards a SECURITY control (authentication, authorization, input validation, or an access check)?
Is a security-relevant failure being swallowed so execution continues as if it had succeeded?
Would an attacker gain anything (auth/validation bypass, info leak, or DoS) from this error being ignored?
keep_if: a security-relevant failure is silently ignored, letting execution proceed insecurely
